verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.e2b.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs. Per-page markdown versions (e.g. quickstart.md) are also served, and each tells agents to fetch the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.
